paired_evaluation.primary_ratio: R = sum(candidate_mse_i) / sum(baseline_mse_i), all32 with equal network weight. This matches the pooled final-error objective for equal billing.
paired_evaluation.uncertainty: Paired network bootstrap:100000 resamples of32 network indices with replacement, preserving baseline/candidate pairing; NumPy PCG64 seed2026101101; recompute ratio of sums in each resample; percentile two-sided95% interval at2.5 and97.5 percent, quantile method linear. Network is resampling unit, not neuron. Preserve script/hash and bootstrap settings.
paired_evaluation.torch_accuracy_pass: All32 complete valid pairs; observed R<1 and upper97.5% bootstrap endpoint<1. No arbitrary minimum percent gain.
secondary_metrics: Noise-subtracted pooled ratio, subtracting the same estimated truth variance from each member of each pair; report diagnostic only
Mean paired log-ratio and its network SE
Win count, full per-seed values, worst regressions
Arithmetic mean paired MSE difference with its uncertainty as a diagnostic
paired_evaluation.note: Shared MC noise cancels bias of paired MSE difference, but inflates the denominator and can attenuate percent gains. Keep raw pooled ratio primary; do not switch metrics after seeing results.

required_after_torch_pass: Build exact same frozen physics/learned candidate as native safe+twin
Per-layer parity on651/378 with the certified simulation and unchanged baseline bridge
Paired native comparison against S46 using the established ten-network panel; measure final error, per-network flops, adjusted score and prediction drift
Evaluate score_i = mse_i * max(0.1, flops_i / 2**41) before pooling; do not substitute product of mean MSE and mean utilization
Complete the applicable release gate stages and exact archive/source/hash checks for both files
native_stage.promotion: Torch pass is accuracy evidence, not permission to fire by itself. Native bill changes and parity drift must leave a verified net adjusted improvement. If added bill consumes the confidence-supported raw margin or native parity materially contradicts it, hold the unchanged candidate for additional qualification; do not tune it on final32. More native evaluation of the identical frozen pair is verification, not a new fit.
native_stage.same_bill_case: Show measured/source evidence for unchanged bill rather than assuming learned-weight changes cannot affect data-dependent work.
native_stage.native_uncertainty: Report paired native adjusted changes and uncertainty. A small ten-network panel need not independently reproduce95% significance already established by32 generated networks, but it must support parity/cost transfer. Material contradictions require resolution before fire.

failure_handling.no_exclusions: Do not silently drop malformed, missing or failed networks. No substitute seeds.
failure_handling.incomplete: Missing pairs mean incomplete, not pass; poll knownlive job or resume only after confirmed terminal/missing handle.
failure_handling.transient_infrastructure_failure: May retry same unchanged pair/seed only for documented infrastructure failure, preserving prior failure records. Never retry or choose the best valid stochastic outcome.
failure_handling.candidate_numeric_or_resource_failure: Fail promotion and preserve all artifacts. A changed candidate is a new experiment and needs a new untouched final block.
failure_handling.inconclusive_or_failed_statistics: Do not tune or keep adding seeds to this result until it passes. Archive full verdict; continue new training/physics on nonfinal data and reserve a fresh final block for a changed candidate.

authorization: Implements root instruction before sealed final32 is opened. No evaluation, truth label read, new seed use, external write or candidate promotion performed.
